scientific_question: Which omitted real state changes explain production-scale A0/A1/A2 matched visual counterfactual differences: EE orientation, object motion, contact branching, EE-object relative geometry, or a combination?

frozen_upstream.transitive_ledger: configs/counterfactual_physical_visual_probe_protocol.json transitively hash-checks C0-v2, C1-v2.1 generator/scale, D13/D14/D15, WM-v2A/B/B.1/C-EJ, matched branches, reports, results, and checkpoints.

scope.bootstrap_and_split_unit: matched branch point retaining all three pairs and eight horizons

replay.environment: fresh environment for every candidate branch
replay.initialization: official init state plus deterministic replay of the frozen 64-action raw prefix
replay.candidate: exact frozen A0/A1/A2 tensor regenerated and byte-compared, then copied one candidate per branch
replay.future_reproduction: replayed future RGB must be bitwise equal and 12-D proprio max absolute difference must be zero versus the frozen source sidecar

prefix_identity_gate.executed_raw_prefix_actions: bitwise equal float32 arrays and identical SHA-256
prefix_identity_gate.agentview_rgb: bitwise equal uint8 arrays and identical SHA-256
prefix_identity_gate.planning_observation: same keys, shapes, dtypes, and bitwise-equal numeric arrays

state_inventory.field_name_policy: discover and record actual runtime fields; do not infer absent names

feature_contract.F_EJ: 10 signed train-standardized differential coordinates: ee_pos[0:3] plus joints[5:12]; gripper excluded
feature_contract.F_ROT: 3-D relative rotation vector plus geodesic angle from rotation matrices; quaternion q/-q invariant
feature_contract.F_OBJECT: across task-declared relevant manipulable objects: mean translation vector, mean relative rotvec, max/mean translation norm, max/mean rotation angle (10-D); object-wise poses retained
feature_contract.F_CONTACT: four verified binary contact splits (robot-object, object-environment, gripper-object, grasp helper), any split, four onset differences, four duration differences (13-D)
feature_contract.F_REL: object-minus-EE relative position and object-to-EE relative orientation, aggregated as mean differential vectors plus max/mean position and rotation magnitudes (10-D)
feature_contract.unavailable_rule: preserve the slot as UNAVAILABLE and do not reorder the hierarchy
feature_contract.future_oracle_rule: future EE/object/contact/relative state is mechanism-only and is forbidden as a deployable input

targets.secondary_gate: evaluate a feature extension's calibration-frozen multi-output ridge only if its primary scalar extension passes the held-out gate

probe.model: closed-form ridge regression with intercept for every S0-S4 set
probe.feature_normalization: calibration-only mean/std; constant dimensions use scale 1
probe.hyperparameter_selection: leave-one-init-state-out CV inside init31-34; minimum mean fold RMSE; exact tie chooses larger alpha

association.contact_conditioning: compare same versus different verified contact states with distribution summaries and branch bootstrap
association.object_motion_bins: low/medium/high by calibration-only 1/3 and 2/3 quantiles of max relevant-object translation; freeze before evaluation

shuffle.rule: shuffle only the newly added group across branch points within identical task, horizon, and candidate pair; fixed derangement; keep parent features and target fixed

bootstrap.unit: task-stratified matched branch point retaining all 24 correlated pair/horizon rows

gates.increment_rule: relative held-out RMSE improvement >=5% and branch-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound >0
gates.shuffle_rule: held-out shuffled-group relative RMSE degradation >0 and branch-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound >0
gates.association_rule: aggregate Spearman >=0.10 and branch-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound >0
gates.rotation: action-rotation to real-EE-rotation association passes, real-EE-rotation to visual association passes, and S1 vs S0 increment passes
gates.object: S2 vs S1 increment and object shuffle pass; translation-max or rotation-max association passes; at least three tasks have positive point Spearman
gates.contact: verified contact-different visual mean exceeds contact-same with CI lower >0; S3 vs S2 increment and contact shuffle pass
gates.relative: S4 vs S3 increment and relative-group shuffle pass; relative-translation-max or relative-rotation-max association passes
gates.robot_kinematics_only_insufficient: S0 fails the same 5% plus positive-CI improvement rule against the calibration-mean constant baseline
gates.multi_factor: two or more new feature groups pass their complete gate
gates.no_tested_state: no new feature group passes its complete gate

forbidden: use historical init30/35 for fitting, thresholds, or model selection
read evaluation state variables before the calibration weights, object bins, and hyperparameters are committed
randomly split the 960 correlated pair/horizon rows
use future object/contact/relative state as a deployable model or controller input
train or modify any World Model, CLIP encoder, C0 actor, candidate generator, production noise, reranker, or controller
run C1/C2/D20-v2, controller success, task outcome, reward, or done
train seed23/47 or manufacture a fake counterfactual target
change the candidate generator or noise scale from audit results
overwrite any upstream report, result, checkpoint, or sidecar
